title: ZEY' BREAK
summary: This article introduces "ZEY' BREAK," a performance featuring choreography by Kadir Memis alias "Amigo." It includes contributions from Zula Lemes for consultation and Nevzat Akpinar for composition. The performance stars Kadir Memis and Yavuz Topuz alias "Risk One" and was presented at Ballhaus Naunynstrasse.
